title: Fenced div info string starts with `-`
message: A fenced div's opening line cannot continue with a word that starts with `-`. `::: --` followed by a space or the end of the line opens a block deletion mark; for a class, write `::: {.name}` or a name that starts with a letter, digit or `_`.
hints: To mark the div's content as deleted, put a space or the end of the line after the two dashes: `::: --`.
Quarto 1 and Pandoc read `::: --foo` as a div with class `--foo`. Quarto 2 reserves a leading `-` after `:::` for block editorial marks, the block form of `[-- deleted text]`.

cases.name: dash-prefixed-word
cases.description: A word starting with `-` after `::: `. `::: --foo`, `::: ---`, `::: -x` and `::: -` all reach this state.

cases.name: dash-prefixed-word-in-container
cases.description: The same opener inside a list item or a block quote reaches a different state from the top-level one.

cases.name: no-space-after-colons
cases.description: `:::--foo`, with no space after the colons, is its own state.
